6weeks minimum => up to 3m0.

⇨Combination of medicine + Bladder Retraining if Frequency is the problem.

2nd line: Medical Treatment Anticholinergics.

⇨Oxybutynin – 1st line, Avoid in old age due to CNS effects.
⇨Tropsium – suitable for old with CNS problem (Don’t cross BBB)
⇨Darifenacin – suitable for old.

⇨Transdermal: if women can’t tolerate orally or severe S/E.
